text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ACME Retail (mid-market) is at 28% product activation, onboarding stalled, renewal in ~45 days. I want to try a short 'preservation pulse' to protect the deal without heavy ops. Idea below, feedback? :thinking_face:

ben: Can you drop the key metrics so we can size the intervention?

maria: Sure — pulled this from console: `active_seats: 120`, `engaged_users_30d: 34`, `key feature A adoption: 22%`, `monthly calls: 1`, `open support tickets: 3 (setup/config)`

sanjay: That signal screams "outcome clarity + enablement". Suggest a 10-day pulse: Day 0 = 20-min health sync to align on outcomes; Day 2 = tailored micro-training (30m) on feature A; Day 5 = adoption checklist + template emails; Day 9 = final review + renewal prep. Escalate if no response by Day 6.

ellie: I can run the micro-training and share a one-pager 'Outcome Anchor' with them. Template: 1) desired business outcome, 2) 3 high-impact actions, 3) measurement. Quick sample I can send: 
```
Outcome: Reduce manual reconciliation time by 50%\nActions: enable feature A mapping; enable X workflow; 2 training hours for ops team\nMetrics: weekly reconciliation time (baseline + target)\n```

ben: Love it. Operational checklist for CS: 
- Reach out with a 2-option calendar invite (health sync) within 24h
- Attach Outcome Anchor + 15-min prep doc
- Schedule micro-training (Ellie) within 48h of sync
- Run adoption checklist (we have a short rubric) Day 5
- If adoption delta <15% by Day 6 -> escalate to AE (Kevin) + propose 1-month onboarding extension or 10% credit

maria: I'll DM Kevin about the potential AE escalation path. Will also add a quick customer note capturing the value props used during the training.

ellie: I'll draft the session and drop the 15-slide micro deck in #cs-assets and tag @maria for review.

ops-bot: Onboarding task created: "Preservation pulse — ACME Retail" assigned to maria, ben, ellie, due 10 days. Task ID: TB-54321

ben: Small but important tweak — capture a single customer quote during the micro-session to use in renewal comms. Even one line helps.

maria: Agreed. I'll take notes and ask for that in the final review. I'll kick off the calendar invites now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sanjay: If anyone wants a quick playbook doc I can spin one up from this thread and the rubric we use for low-touch saves. Happy to post it to /cs-playbooks.

ellie: Please do. A 1-page playbook + one-pager Outcome Anchor should be enough for this low-touch cohort.

maria: Great — we'll run this as a trial on 3 accounts in this segment and report back in 2 weeks with adoption delta and renewal risk change.
